name: Tsuma x Heaven
source:
The protagonist, Yuuji, is a ronin studying hard to get into college.  His parents sell his childhood home and move abroad, throwing him out of the house.  His recently married older brother, Yuuichi, offers him a room.  Yuuji feels awkward intruding on his brother's newlywed life, but takes Yuuichi up on the offer.

Yuuji walks into a new life of bewilderment, though, as he suddenly starts having sexy encounters with his new sister-in-law and the seductive housewife next-door.
translation:
主人公雄二是一个为了考大学而努力学习的浪人。他的父母卖掉了他童年的房子并移居国外，将他赶出了家门。他新婚的哥哥Yuuichi为他提供了一个房间。雄二对于闯入哥哥的新婚生活感到尴尬，但还是接受了雄一的提议。

然而，雄二开始了一种困惑的新生活，因为他突然开始与他的新嫂子和隔壁迷人的家庭主妇发生性感的邂逅。
